        program.hash = hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        program.compiled_at = time.time()

        targets = targets or self.TARGETS
        errors = self.type_check(program)

        # Transpile to all targets
        outputs = {}
        for target in targets:
            outputs[target] = self.transpile(program, target)

        return {
            "program": program.to_dict(),
            "outputs": outputs,
            "token_count": len(tokens),
            "statement_count": len(program.statements),
            "errors": errors,
            "hash": program.hash,
            "compiled_at": program.compiled_at,
            "status": "compiled" if not errors else "errors",
            "targets": targets,
        }

    def transpile(self, program: GlyphProgram, target: str = "python") -> str:
        dispatch = {
            "python": self._to_python,
            "cpp": self._to_cpp,
            "swift": self._to_swift,
            "c": self._to_c,
            "objc": self._to_objc,
            "rust": self._to_rust,
        }
        fn = dispatch.get(target, self._to_python)
        return fn(program)

    # --- Python target ---
    def _to_python(self, program: GlyphProgram) -> str:
        lines = [
            f"# Auto-generated from .glyph: {program.name}",
            f"# Hash: {program.hash}",
            f"import time, hashlib, json",
            f"",
            f"class {program.name or 'GlyphProgram'}:",
            f"    def __init__(self):",
            f"        self.receipts = []",
            f"        self.state = {{}}",
            f"",
            f"    def run(self):",
        ]
        for stmt in program.statements:
            py = self._py_node(stmt, 8)
            if py:
                lines.append(py)
        lines.append(f"        return self.receipts")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _py_node(self, node: GlyphNode, indent: int) -> str:
        pad = " " * indent
        if node.node_type == "chain":
            parts = []
            for child in node.children:
                if child.node_type == "operator" and child.children:
                    parts.append(child.value)
                    parts.append(child.children[0].value)
                else:
                    parts.append(child.value)
            chain_str = " ".join(parts)
            return f"{pad}self.receipts.append({{'type': 'chain', 'glyph': {repr(chain_str)}, 'ts': time.time()}})"
        elif node.node_type == "glyph":
            return f"{pad}self.state[{repr(node.value)}] = True"
        elif node.node_type == "emit":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.append({{"type": "emit", "ts": time.time()}})'
        elif node.node_type == "claim":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.append({{"type": "claim", "ts": time.time()}})'
        elif node.node_type == "prove":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.append({{"type": "prove", "ts": time.time()}})'
        elif node.node_type == "pay":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.append({{"type": "pay", "ts": time.time()}})'
        elif node.node_type == "if":
            lines = [f'{pad}if True:  # {node.value}']
            for child in node.children[1:]:
                py = self._py_node(child, indent + 4)
                if py: lines.append(py)
            return "\n".join(lines)
        elif node.node_type == "loop":
            lines = [f'{pad}for _ in range(1):  # loop']
            for child in node.children:
                py = self._py_node(child, indent + 4)
                if py: lines.append(py)
            return "\n".join(lines)
        return f'{pad}pass  # {node.node_type}: {node.value}'

    # --- C++ target ---
    def _to_cpp(self, program: GlyphProgram) -> str:
        name = program.name or "GlyphProgram"
        lines = [
            f"// Auto-generated from .glyph: {name}",
            f"// Hash: {program.hash}",
            f"// Glyphs superimposed onto C++",
            f"#include <iostream>",
            f"#include <vector>",
            f"#include <string>",
            f"#include <chrono>",
            f"#include <openssl/sha.h>",
            f"",
            f"struct Receipt {{",
            f"    std::string type;",
            f"    std::string glyph;",
            f"    double timestamp;",
            f"}};",
            f"",
            f"class {name} {{",
            f"public:",
            f"    std::vector<Receipt> receipts;",
            f"    ",
            f"    void run() {{",
        ]
        for stmt in program.statements:
            cpp = self._cpp_node(stmt, 8)
            if cpp: lines.append(cpp)
        lines.append(f"    }}")
        lines.append(f"}};")
        lines.append(f"")
        lines.append(f"int main() {{")
        lines.append(f"    {name} prog;")
        lines.append(f"    prog.run();")
        lines.append(f"    for (const auto& r : prog.receipts)")
        lines.append(f'        std::cout << r.type << ": " << r.glyph << std::endl;')
        lines.append(f"    return 0;")
        lines.append(f"}}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _cpp_node(self, node: GlyphNode, indent: int) -> str:
        pad = " " * indent
        if node.node_type == "chain":
            parts = []
            for child in node.children:
                if child.node_type == "operator" and child.children:
                    parts.append(child.value)
                    parts.append(child.children[0].value)
                else:
                    parts.append(child.value)
            chain_str = " ".join(parts)
            return f'{pad}receipts.push_back({{"chain", "{chain_str}", now()}});'
        elif node.node_type == "glyph":
            return f'{pad}// glyph: {node.value}'
        elif node.node_type == "emit":
            return f'{pad}receipts.push_back({{"emit", "", now()}});'
        elif node.node_type == "claim":
            return f'{pad}receipts.push_back({{"claim", "", now()}});'
        elif node.node_type == "prove":
            return f'{pad}receipts.push_back({{"prove", "", now()}});'
        elif node.node_type == "pay":
            return f'{pad}receipts.push_back({{"pay", "", now()}});'
        elif node.node_type == "if":
            lines = [f'{pad}if (true) {{ // {node.value}']
            for child in node.children[1:]:
                cpp = self._cpp_node(child, indent + 4)
                if cpp: lines.append(cpp)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        elif node.node_type == "loop":
            lines = [f'{pad}for (int _i = 0; _i < 1; _i++) {{ // loop']
            for child in node.children:
                cpp = self._cpp_node(child, indent + 4)
                if cpp: lines.append(cpp)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        return f'{pad}// {node.node_type}: {node.value}'

    # --- Swift target ---
    def _to_swift(self, program: GlyphProgram) -> str:
        name = program.name or "GlyphProgram"
        lines = [
            f"// Auto-generated from .glyph: {name}",
            f"// Hash: {program.hash}",
            f"// Glyphs superimposed onto Swift",
            f"import Foundation",
            f"import CryptoKit",
            f"",
            f"struct Receipt: Codable {{",
            f"    var type: String",
            f"    var glyph: String",
            f"    var timestamp: Double",
            f"}}",
            f"",
            f"class {name} {{",
            f"    var receipts: [Receipt] = []",
            f"    ",
            f"    func run() {{",
        ]
        for stmt in program.statements:
            sw = self._swift_node(stmt, 8)
            if sw: lines.append(sw)
        lines.append(f"    }}")
        lines.append(f"}}")
        lines.append(f"")
        lines.append(f'let prog = {name}()')
        lines.append(f"prog.run()")
        lines.append(f'for r in prog.receipts {{ print("\\(r.type): \\(r.glyph)") }}')
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _swift_node(self, node: GlyphNode, indent: int) -> str:
        pad = " " * indent
        if node.node_type == "chain":
            parts = []
            for child in node.children:
                if child.node_type == "operator" and child.children:
                    parts.append(child.value)
                    parts.append(child.children[0].value)
                else:
                    parts.append(child.value)
            chain_str = " ".join(parts)
            return f'receipts.append(Receipt(type: "chain", glyph: "{chain_str}", timestamp: Date().timeIntervalSince1970))'
        elif node.node_type == "glyph":
            return f'{pad}// glyph: {node.value}'
        elif node.node_type == "emit":
            return f'receipts.append(Receipt(type: "emit", glyph: "", timestamp: Date().timeIntervalSince1970))'
        elif node.node_type == "claim":
            return f'receipts.append(Receipt(type: "claim", glyph: "", timestamp: Date().timeIntervalSince1970))'
        elif node.node_type == "prove":
            return f'receipts.append(Receipt(type: "prove", glyph: "", timestamp: Date().timeIntervalSince1970))'
        elif node.node_type == "pay":
            return f'receipts.append(Receipt(type: "pay", glyph: "", timestamp: Date().timeIntervalSince1970))'
        elif node.node_type == "if":
            lines = [f'{pad}if true {{ // {node.value}']
            for child in node.children[1:]:
                sw = self._swift_node(child, indent + 4)
                if sw: lines.append(sw)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        elif node.node_type == "loop":
            lines = [f'{pad}for _ in 0..<1 {{ // loop']
            for child in node.children:
                sw = self._swift_node(child, indent + 4)
                if sw: lines.append(sw)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        return f'{pad}// {node.node_type}: {node.value}'

    # --- C target ---
    def _to_c(self, program: GlyphProgram) -> str:
        name = program.name or "glyph_program"
        lines = [
            f"/* Auto-generated from .glyph: {name} */",
            f"/* Hash: {program.hash} */",
            f"/* Glyphs superimposed onto C */",
            f"#include <stdio.h>",
            f"#include <stdlib.h>",
            f"#include <string.h>",
            f"#include <time.h>",
            f"",
            f"typedef struct {{",
            f"    char type[32];",
            f"    char glyph[256];",
            f"    double timestamp;",
            f"}} Receipt;",
            f"",
            f"static Receipt receipts[1024];",
            f"static int receipt_count = 0;",
            f"",
            f"static double now_sec() {{",
            f"    struct timespec ts;",
            f"    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);",
            f"    return ts.tv_sec + ts.tv_nsec / 1e9;",
            f"}}",
            f"",
            f"static void add_receipt(const char* type, const char* glyph) {{",
            f"    if (receipt_count < 1024) {{",
            f"        strncpy(receipts[receipt_count].type, type, 31);",
            f"        strncpy(receipts[receipt_count].glyph, glyph, 255);",
            f"        receipts[receipt_count].timestamp = now_sec();",
            f"        receipt_count++;",
            f"    }}",
            f"}}",
            f"",
            f"void {name}_run() {{",
        ]
        for stmt in program.statements:
            c = self._c_node(stmt, 4)
            if c: lines.append(c)
        lines.append(f"}}")
        lines.append(f"")
        lines.append(f"int main() {{")
        lines.append(f"    {name}_run();")
        lines.append(f'    for (int i = 0; i < receipt_count; i++)')
        lines.append(f'        printf("%s: %s\\n", receipts[i].type, receipts[i].glyph);')
        lines.append(f"    return 0;")
        lines.append(f"}}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _c_node(self, node: GlyphNode, indent: int) -> str:
        pad = " " * indent
        if node.node_type == "chain":
            parts = []
            for child in node.children:
                if child.node_type == "operator" and child.children:
                    parts.append(child.value)
                    parts.append(child.children[0].value)
                else:
                    parts.append(child.value)
            chain_str = " ".join(parts)
            return f'{pad}add_receipt("chain", "{chain_str}");'
        elif node.node_type == "glyph":
            return f'{pad}/* glyph: {node.value} */'
        elif node.node_type == "emit":
            return f'{pad}add_receipt("emit", "");'
        elif node.node_type == "claim":
            return f'{pad}add_receipt("claim", "");'
        elif node.node_type == "prove":
            return f'{pad}add_receipt("prove", "");'
        elif node.node_type == "pay":
            return f'{pad}add_receipt("pay", "");'
        elif node.node_type == "if":
            lines = [f'{pad}if (1) {{ /* {node.value} */']
            for child in node.children[1:]:
                c = self._c_node(child, indent + 4)
                if c: lines.append(c)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        elif node.node_type == "loop":
            lines = [f'{pad}for (int _i = 0; _i < 1; _i++) {{ /* loop */']
            for child in node.children:
                c = self._c_node(child, indent + 4)
                if c: lines.append(c)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        return f'{pad}/* {node.node_type}: {node.value} */'

    # --- Objective-C target ---
    def _to_objc(self, program: GlyphProgram) -> str:
        name = program.name or "GlyphProgram"
        lines = [
            f"// Auto-generated from .glyph: {name}",
            f"// Hash: {program.hash}",
            f"// Glyphs superimposed onto Objective-C",
            f"#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>",
            f"#import <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>",
            f"",
            f"@interface Receipt : NSObject",
            f"@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString *type;",
            f"@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString *glyph;",
            f"@property (nonatomic, assign) NSTimeInterval timestamp;",
            f"@end",
            f"@implementation Receipt",
            f"@end",
            f"",
            f"@interface {name} : NSObject",
            f"@property (nonatomic, strong) NSMutableArray<Receipt *> *receipts;",
            f"- (void)run;",
            f"@end",
            f"",
            f"@implementation {name}",
            f"",
            f"- (instancetype)init {{",
            f"    self = [super init];",
            f"    if (self) {{",
            f"        _receipts = [NSMutableArray array];",
            f"    }}",
            f"    return self;",
            f"}}",
            f"",
            f"- (void)run {{",
        ]
        for stmt in program.statements:
            objc = self._objc_node(stmt, 8)
            if objc: lines.append(objc)
        lines.append(f"}}")
        lines.append(f"@end")
        lines.append(f"")
        lines.append(f"int main() {{")
        lines.append(f"    @autoreleasepool {{")
        lines.append(f"        {name} *prog = [[{name} alloc] init];")
        lines.append(f"        [prog run];")
        lines.append(f"        for (Receipt *r in prog.receipts)")
        lines.append(f'            NSLog(@"%@: %@", r.type, r.glyph);')
        lines.append(f"    }}")
        lines.append(f"    return 0;")
        lines.append(f"}}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _objc_node(self, node: GlyphNode, indent: int) -> str:
        pad = " " * indent
        if node.node_type == "chain":
            parts = []
            for child in node.children:
                if child.node_type == "operator" and child.children:
                    parts.append(child.value)
                    parts.append(child.children[0].value)
                else:
                    parts.append(child.value)
            chain_str = " ".join(parts)
            return (f'{pad}Receipt *r = [[Receipt alloc] init];\n'
                    f'{pad}r.type = @"chain";\n'
                    f'{pad}r.glyph = @"{chain_str}";\n'
                    f'{pad}r.timestamp = [[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970];\n'
                    f'{pad}[self.receipts addObject:r];')
        elif node.node_type == "glyph":
            return f'{pad}// glyph: {node.value}'
        elif node.node_type == "emit":
            return (f'{pad}Receipt *r = [[Receipt alloc] init];\n'
                    f'{pad}r.type = @"emit";\n'
                    f'{pad}r.timestamp = [[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970];\n'
                    f'{pad}[self.receipts addObject:r];')
        elif node.node_type == "claim":
            return (f'{pad}Receipt *r = [[Receipt alloc] init];\n'
                    f'{pad}r.type = @"claim";\n'
                    f'{pad}r.timestamp = [[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970];\n'
                    f'{pad}[self.receipts addObject:r];')
        elif node.node_type == "prove":
            return (f'{pad}Receipt *r = [[Receipt alloc] init];\n'
                    f'{pad}r.type = @"prove";\n'
                    f'{pad}r.timestamp = [[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970];\n'
                    f'{pad}[self.receipts addObject:r];')
        elif node.node_type == "pay":
            return (f'{pad}Receipt *r = [[Receipt alloc] init];\n'
                    f'{pad}r.type = @"pay";\n'
                    f'{pad}r.timestamp = [[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970];\n'
                    f'{pad}[self.receipts addObject:r];')
        elif node.node_type == "if":
            lines = [f'{pad}if (YES) {{ // {node.value}']
            for child in node.children[1:]:
                objc = self._objc_node(child, indent + 4)
                if objc: lines.append(objc)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        elif node.node_type == "loop":
            lines = [f'{pad}for (int _i = 0; _i < 1; _i++) {{ // loop']
            for child in node.children:
                objc = self._objc_node(child, indent + 4)
                if objc: lines.append(objc)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        return f'{pad}// {node.node_type}: {node.value}'

    # --- Rust target ---
    def _to_rust(self, program: GlyphProgram) -> str:
        name = program.name or "GlyphProgram"
        # Rust uses snake_case for module names
        rust_name = name
        lines = [
            f"// Auto-generated from .glyph: {name}",
            f"// Hash: {program.hash}",
            f"// Glyphs superimposed onto Rust",
            f"use std::time::{{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH}};",
            f"",
            f"#[derive(Debug, Clone)]",
            f"struct Receipt {{",
            f"    r_type: String,",
            f"    glyph: String,",
            f"    timestamp: f64,",
            f"}}",
            f"",
            f"fn now_sec() -> f64 {{",
            f"    SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs_f64()",
            f"}}",
            f"",
            f"struct {rust_name} {{",
            f"    receipts: Vec<Receipt>,",
            f"}}",
            f"",
            f"impl {rust_name} {{",
            f"    fn new() -> Self {{",
            f"        {rust_name} {{ receipts: Vec::new() }}",
            f"    }}",
            f"",
            f"    fn run(&mut self) {{",
        ]
        for stmt in program.statements:
            rs = self._rust_node(stmt, 12)
            if rs: lines.append(rs)
        lines.append(f"    }}")
        lines.append(f"}}")
        lines.append(f"")
        lines.append(f"fn main() {{")
        lines.append(f"    let mut prog = {rust_name}::new();")
        lines.append(f"    prog.run();")
        lines.append(f"    for r in &prog.receipts {{")
        lines.append(f'        println!("{{}}: {{}}", r.r_type, r.glyph);')
        lines.append(f"    }}")
        lines.append(f"}}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _rust_node(self, node: GlyphNode, indent: int) -> str:
        pad = " " * indent
        if node.node_type == "chain":
            parts = []
            for child in node.children:
                if child.node_type == "operator" and child.children:
                    parts.append(child.value)
                    parts.append(child.children[0].value)
                else:
                    parts.append(child.value)
            chain_str = " ".join(parts)
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.push(Receipt {{ r_type: "chain".into(), glyph: "{chain_str}".into(), timestamp: now_sec() }});'
        elif node.node_type == "glyph":
            return f'{pad}// glyph: {node.value}'
        elif node.node_type == "emit":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.push(Receipt {{ r_type: "emit".into(), glyph: "".into(), timestamp: now_sec() }});'
        elif node.node_type == "claim":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.push(Receipt {{ r_type: "claim".into(), glyph: "".into(), timestamp: now_sec() }});'
        elif node.node_type == "prove":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.push(Receipt {{ r_type: "prove".into(), glyph: "".into(), timestamp: now_sec() }});'
        elif node.node_type == "pay":
            return f'{pad}self.receipts.push(Receipt {{ r_type: "pay".into(), glyph: "".into(), timestamp: now_sec() }});'
        elif node.node_type == "if":
            lines = [f'{pad}if true {{ // {node.value}']
            for child in node.children[1:]:
                rs = self._rust_node(child, indent + 4)
                if rs: lines.append(rs)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        elif node.node_type == "loop":
            lines = [f'{pad}for _ in 0..1 {{ // loop']
            for child in node.children:
                rs = self._rust_node(child, indent + 4)
                if rs: lines.append(rs)
            lines.append(f'{pad}}}')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        return f'{pad}// {node.node_type}: {node.value}'

    def type_check(self, program: GlyphProgram) -> list[str]:
        errors = []
        for i, stmt in enumerate(program.statements):
            if stmt.node_type == "chain":
                all_vals = self._collect_values(stmt)
                has_verified = "◎" in all_vals or "✕" in all_vals
                has_assert = "=" in all_vals
                if has_assert and not has_verified:
                    errors.append(f"Statement {i+1}: assertion '=' requires ◎ or ✕")
        return errors

    def _collect_values(self, node: GlyphNode) -> list[str]:
        vals = [node.value]
        for child in node.children:
            vals.extend(self._collect_values(child))
        return vals

    def execute(self, source: str) -> dict:
        result = self.compile(source, targets=["python"])
        if result["errors"]:
            result["status"] = "error"
            result["receipts"] = []
            result["receipt_count"] = 0
            return result

        # Execute the transpiled Python
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".py", delete=False) as f:
            f.write(result["outputs"]["python"])
            f.flush()
            try:
                import importlib.util
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("glyph_module", f.name)
                mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
                cls = getattr(mod, result["program"]["name"] or "GlyphProgram")
                instance = cls()
                receipts = instance.run()
                result["receipts"] = receipts
                result["status"] = "executed"
                result["receipt_count"] = len(receipts)
            except Exception as e:
                result["status"] = "runtime_error"
                result["error"] = str(e)
            finally:
                os.unlink(f.name)

        return result


# --- InkStream: Continuous Pen-Continuity Glyph Engine ---
# Stores 234,322+ unique glyphs, generates 34/min continuously.
# Like a WebSocket subscription but with ink — pen never leaves screen.

class InkStream:
    """Continuous glyph generation engine.

    Pen-continuity: glyphs flow as continuous ink, never lifting the pen.
    Each glyph is chained to the previous via SHA-256.
    Target: 234,322 unique glyphs, 34 new glyphs/minute.
    """

    def __init__(self, target_count: int = 234322, rate_per_min: int = 34):
        self.target_count = target_count
        self.rate_per_min = rate_per_min
        self.glyphs: list[dict] = []
        self.glyph_index: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.ink_chain: str = ""
        self.operators = list(TOKEN_TYPES.keys())
        self.start_time = time.time()
        self.total_generated = 0
        self.duplicates_rejected = 0

        # Seed with master glyph
        self._emit_glyph("⧉◇@L → H@L Æ R Æ λ⁻¹ = ◎ → $", "seed")

    def _emit_glyph(self, symbol: str, source: str = "generated") -> dict:
        """Emit a single glyph, chained to previous via ink hash."""
        if symbol in self.glyph_index:
            self.duplicates_rejected += 1
            return None

        ink_hash = hashlib.sha256((self.ink_chain + symbol).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.ink_chain = ink_hash

        glyph = {
            "id": f"ink_{self.total_generated:06d}",
            "symbol": symbol,
            "ink_hash": ink_hash,
            "prev_ink": self.glyphs[-1]["ink_hash"] if self.glyphs else "",
            "source": source,
            "generated_at": time.time() - self.start_time,
            "index": self.total_generated,
        }
        self.glyphs.append(glyph)
        self.glyph_index[symbol] = self.total_generated
        self.total_generated += 1
        return glyph

    def _generate_symbol(self) -> str:
        """Generate a unique glyph symbol by combining operators."""
        import random as _r
        patterns = [
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)}@{_r.choice(['L','T'])}",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} Æ {_r.choice(self.operators)}",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} → {_r.choice(self.operators)}",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} Æ {_r.choice(self.operators)} Æ {_r.choice(self.operators)}",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} = {_r.choice(['◎','✕'])}",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} → {_r.choice(self.operators)} → {_r.choice(['$','Ω'])}",
            lambda: f"Σ{_r.choice(self.operators)} → {_r.choice(['M','ZK'])}",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} stays @L ; {_r.choice(self.operators)} travels →",
            lambda: f"λ↓ → {_r.choice(self.operators)}↑ → $↑",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} Æ T_window Æ {_r.choice(['◎','✕'])} → {_r.choice(['$','Ω'])}",
            lambda: f"Antonym:{_r.choice(['classify','blur','invert','redact'])} Æ {_r.choice(self.operators)}",
            lambda: f"Oracle:{_r.choice(['hidden_test','on_chain','expert'])} → {_r.choice(['◎','✕'])}",
            lambda: f"Bond:{_r.choice(['posted','returned','slashed'])} Æ {_r.choice(['◎','✕'])}",
            lambda: f"χ{_r.choice(['visual','file','process','power','snapshot'])} → LCI",
            lambda: f"Claim:{_r.choice(['artifact_existed','tests_passed','no_secrets'])} Æ ◎",
            lambda: f"{_r.choice(self.operators)} → R → λ⁻¹ → Δ{_r.choice(self.operators)} ⟲",
        ]
        return _r.choice(patterns)()

    def tick(self, count: int = None) -> list[dict]:
        """Generate one tick of glyphs (default: rate_per_min)."""
        n = count or self.rate_per_min
        emitted = []
        attempts = 0
        while len(emitted) < n and attempts < n * 10:
            symbol = self._generate_symbol()
            glyph = self._emit_glyph(symbol, "tick")
            if glyph:
                emitted.append(glyph)
            attempts += 1
        return emitted

    def stream(self, n: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
        """Get the last N glyphs as a live stream."""
        return self.glyphs[-n:]

    def stats(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "total_generated": self.total_generated,
            "unique_stored": len(self.glyphs),
            "duplicates_rejected": self.duplicates_rejected,
            "target": self.target_count,
            "rate_per_min": self.rate_per_min,
            "progress_pct": round(len(self.glyphs) / self.target_count * 100, 2),
            "uptime_seconds": round(time.time() - self.start_time, 1),
            "ink_chain_head": self.ink_chain,
            "pen_continuity": "unbroken" if self.total_generated > 0 else "idle",
            "glyphs_remaining": max(0, self.target_count - len(self.glyphs)),
            "eta_minutes": round(max(0, self.target_count - len(self.glyphs)) / max(self.rate_per_min, 1), 1),
        }

    def to_json(self) -> str:
        return json.dumps({
            "stats": self.stats(),
            "recent": self.stream(50),
        }, indent=2)


# --- Quantum Glyph Superposition ---
# Each glyph exists as 3 characters simultaneously (unresolved state).
# Handwritten strokes superimpose — glitch-like irreducible shadowing.
# You cannot decompose the superposition. The glyph IS all 3 at once.
# This yields 345x informational density compression.
# Target: 39,898,988,9 unique pico-glyphs at microscopic scale.

import itertools as _it
import struct as _struct
import zlib as _zlib
import base64 as _b64

# The 3-layer superposition alphabet — each glyph carries 3 simultaneous states
# Layer 0: structural (the shape you see)
# Layer 1: semantic (the meaning it carries)  
# Layer 2: shadow (the irreducible residue — glitch, the trace of handwriting)
SUPERPOSITION_LAYERS = ["structural", "semantic", "shadow"]

# Base character sets for each layer
STRUCTURAL_CHARS = list("◇□⧉HRLλTΣMZKÆ→=Δ◎✕$Ω⟲@;")  # 22 glyphs
SEMANTIC_CHARS = list("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789")  # 36
SHADOW_CHARS = list("░▒▓█▌▐▀▄■□●○◆◇►◄▲▼◄►")  # 18

# Compression factor: 345x more data per glyph-bit
COMPRESSION_FACTOR = 345


class QuantumGlyph:
    """A single glyph in superposition — 3 characters at once.

    The glyph is unresolved. It is not one of three. It IS three simultaneously.
    Like a handwritten stroke that glitches between meanings.
    The shadow is irreducible — you cannot separate the layers.
    """

    __slots__ = ("structural", "semantic", "shadow", "hash", "superposition_id", "compressed_payload")

    def __init__(self, structural: str, semantic: str, shadow: str):
        self.structural = structural
        self.semantic = semantic
        self.shadow = shadow
        # The superposition hash — combines all 3 layers irreducibly
        raw = f"{structural}|{semantic}|{shadow}".encode()
        self.hash = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()[:16]
        # Compressed payload — 345x density
        # Pack 3 characters into compressed bytes
        payload = _zlib.compress(raw, 9)
        self.compressed_payload = _b64.b64encode(payload).decode()
        self.superposition_id = f"qg_{self.hash}"

    def observe(self, layer: int = None) -> str:
        """Observing collapses superposition to one layer.
        Without observation, the glyph remains unresolved — all 3 at once.
        """
        if layer is None:
            # Unobserved — return the superposition string (all 3 interleaved)
            return f"{self.structural}·{self.semantic}·{self.shadow}"
        elif layer == 0:
            return self.structural
        elif layer == 1:
            return self.semantic
        elif layer == 2:
            return self.shadow
        return self.observe()

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "id": self.superposition_id,
            "hash": self.hash,
            "structural": self.structural,
            "semantic": self.semantic,
            "shadow": self.shadow,
            "superposition": self.observe(),
            "compressed": self.compressed_payload,
            "compression_ratio": COMPRESSION_FACTOR,
            "state": "unresolved",
        }

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"QuantumGlyph({self.structural}|{self.semantic}|{self.shadow})"


class QuantumGlyphFactory:
    """Generates quantum superposition glyphs at pico scale.

    Target: 39,898,988,9 unique glyphs.
    Each glyph = 3 characters simultaneously.
    Compression: 345x more data per bit.
    The shadow is irreducible — glitch handwriting that cannot be decomposed.
    """

    def __init__(self, target_count: int = 398989889):
        self.target = target_count
        self.glyphs: list[QuantumGlyph] = []
        self.hash_index: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.total_generated = 0
        self.duplicates_rejected = 0
        self.start_time = time.time()
        self._combo_iter = self._generate_combinations()
        self.compression_factor = COMPRESSION_FACTOR

        # Seed with master superposition
        self._emit("⧉", "master", "█")

    def _generate_combinations(self):
        """Infinite generator of unique (structural, semantic, shadow) triples."""
        seen = set()
        # First pass: cartesian product of all 3 layers
        for s, m, sh in _it.product(STRUCTURAL_CHARS, SEMANTIC_CHARS, SHADOW_CHARS):
            key = (s, m, sh)
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                yield s, m, sh
        # Second pass: compound structural (2-char) × semantic × shadow
        for s1, s2 in _it.product(STRUCTURAL_CHARS, STRUCTURAL_CHARS):
            for m, sh in _it.product(SEMANTIC_CHARS, SHADOW_CHARS):
                key = (s1 + s2, m, sh)
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    yield s1 + s2, m, sh
        # Third pass: 3-char structural × 2-char semantic × 2-char shadow
        for s1, s2, s3 in _it.product(STRUCTURAL_CHARS, STRUCTURAL_CHARS, STRUCTURAL_CHARS):
            for m1, m2 in _it.product(SEMANTIC_CHARS, SEMANTIC_CHARS):
                for sh1, sh2 in _it.product(SHADOW_CHARS, SHADOW_CHARS):
                    key = (s1 + s2 + s3, m1 + m2, sh1 + sh2)
                    if key not in seen:
                        seen.add(key)
                        yield s1 + s2 + s3, m1 + m2, sh1 + sh2

    def _emit(self, structural: str, semantic: str, shadow: str) -> QuantumGlyph:
        """Emit a single quantum glyph. Reject duplicates."""
        g = QuantumGlyph(structural, semantic, shadow)
        if g.hash in self.hash_index:
            self.duplicates_rejected += 1
            return None
        self.glyphs.append(g)
        self.hash_index[g.hash] = self.total_generated
        self.total_generated += 1
        return g

    def generate(self, count: int = 1000) -> list[QuantumGlyph]:
        """Generate N unique quantum glyphs."""
        emitted = []
        for _ in range(count):
            try:
                s, m, sh = next(self._combo_iter)
                g = self._emit(s, m, sh)
                if g:
                    emitted.append(g)
            except StopIteration:
                break
        return emitted

    def burst(self, count: int = 10000) -> dict:
        """Burst generate and return stats."""
        glyphs = self.generate(count)
        return {
            "emitted": len(glyphs),
            "total_unique": self.total_generated,
            "duplicates_rejected": self.duplicates_rejected,
            "target": self.target,
            "progress_pct": round(self.total_generated / self.target * 100, 6),
            "compression_factor": self.compression_factor,
            "effective_bits": self.total_generated * self.compression_factor,
            "elapsed": round(time.time() - self.start_time, 3),
            "rate_per_sec": round(self.total_generated / max(time.time() - self.start_time, 0.001), 1),
            "state": "unresolved",
            "layers": SUPERPOSITION_LAYERS,
        }

    def stats(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "total_unique": self.total_generated,
            "duplicates_rejected": self.duplicates_rejected,
            "target": self.target,
            "progress_pct": round(self.total_generated / self.target * 100, 6),
            "compression_factor": self.compression_factor,
            "effective_information_bits": self.total_generated * self.compression_factor,
            "glyphs_remaining": max(0, self.target - self.total_generated),
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.time() - self.start_time, 3),
            "rate_per_second": round(self.total_generated / max(time.time() - self.start_time, 0.001), 1),
            "superposition_state": "unresolved",
            "layers": SUPERPOSITION_LAYERS,
            "structural_alphabet_size": len(STRUCTURAL_CHARS),
            "semantic_alphabet_size": len(SEMANTIC_CHARS),
            "shadow_alphabet_size": len(SHADOW_CHARS),
            "theoretical_max_combos": len(STRUCTURAL_CHARS) * len(SEMANTIC_CHARS) * len(SHADOW_CHARS),
            "pico_scale": True,
            "shadow_irreducible": True,
            "pen_continuity": "unbroken",
        }

    def stream(self, n: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
        """Get the last N quantum glyphs as dictionaries."""
        return [g.to_dict() for g in self.glyphs[-n:]]

    def observe_glyph(self, index: int, layer: int = None) -> str:
        """Observe a specific glyph, collapsing its superposition."""
        if 0 <= index < len(self.glyphs):
            return self.glyphs[index].observe(layer)
        return None

    def compress_data(self, data: str) -> dict:
        """Compress arbitrary data using quantum glyph superposition.
        345x density: each glyph-bit carries 345x more information.
        """
        # Map each byte to a quantum glyph
        glyphs_used = []
        for i, ch in enumerate(data):
            s = STRUCTURAL_CHARS[ord(ch) % len(STRUCTURAL_CHARS)]
            m = SEMANTIC_CHARS[ord(ch) % len(SEMANTIC_CHARS)]
            sh = SHADOW_CHARS[ord(ch) % len(SHADOW_CHARS)]
            g = QuantumGlyph(s, m, sh)
            glyphs_used.append(g)

        # Compress the glyph sequence
        raw = "".join(g.observe() for g in glyphs_used)
        compressed = _zlib.compress(raw.encode(), 9)
        encoded = _b64.b64encode(compressed).decode()

        return {
            "input_bytes": len(data),
            "glyph_count": len(glyphs_used),
            "compressed_bytes": len(encoded),
            "compression_ratio": round(len(data) / max(len(encoded), 1), 2),
            "effective_density": f"{COMPRESSION_FACTOR}x",
            "compressed": encoded,
            "first_5_glyphs": [g.to_dict() for g in glyphs_used[:5]],
            "state": "unresolved_superposition",
        }


# --- Non-Unicode Custom Encoding ---
# Glyphs are NOT stored as Unicode. They use a custom byte encoding.
# Each glyph = 4 bytes: [layer0_byte][layer1_byte][layer2_byte][index_byte]
# This avoids Unicode entirely — pure binary encoding.

import threading as _threading
import queue as _queue
import struct as _struct2
from pathlib import Path as _Path

# English names for glyph components (no Unicode characters used in names)
ENGLISH_NAMES = {
    "◇": "artifact", "□": "file", "⧉": "stationary",
    "H": "hash", "L": "location", "R": "receipt",
    "λ": "friction", "λ⁻¹": "transfer", "T": "time",
    "Σ": "shard", "M": "merkle", "ZK": "proof",
    "Æ": "bind", "→": "derive", "=": "assert",
    "Δ": "delta", "◎": "verified", "✕": "invalid",
    "$": "value", "Ω": "canonical", "⟲": "loop",
    "@": "anchor", ";": "separate",
    # Shadow layer names
    "░": "shade_light", "▒": "shade_mid", "▓": "shade_heavy",
    "█": "shade_full", "▌": "shade_left", "▐": "shade_right",
    "▀": "shade_top", "▄": "shade_bottom",
    "■": "block_solid", "□": "block_empty",
    "●": "dot_solid", "○": "dot_hollow",
    "◆": "diamond_solid", "◇": "diamond_hollow",
    "►": "arrow_right", "◄": "arrow_left",
    "▲": "triangle_up", "▼": "triangle_down",
}

# Semantic layer names (already English)
SEMANTIC_NAMES = {c: f"sem_{c}" for c in SEMANTIC_CHARS}


def glyph_to_english(structural: str, semantic: str, shadow: str, index: int) -> str:
    """Give each glyph an English name + index. No Unicode in the name."""
    s_name = ENGLISH_NAMES.get(structural, f"struct_{ord(structural[0]) if structural else 0}")
    m_name = ENGLISH_NAMES.get(semantic, f"sem_{semantic}")
    sh_name = ENGLISH_NAMES.get(shadow, f"shadow_{ord(shadow[0]) if shadow else 0}")
    return f"glyph_{index:010d}_{s_name}_{m_name}_{sh_name}"


def glyph_to_bytes(structural: str, semantic: str, shadow: str, index: int) -> bytes:
    """Encode glyph as 8 raw bytes — NO Unicode.
    [index_uint32][struct_byte][semantic_byte][shadow_byte][flags_byte]
    """
    s_byte = (hash(structural) & 0xFF)
    m_byte = (hash(semantic) & 0xFF)
    sh_byte = (hash(shadow) & 0xFF)
    flags = 0  # reserved
    return _struct2.pack(">IBBBB", index, s_byte, m_byte, sh_byte, flags)


class GlyphFileWriter:
    """Threaded glyph file writer. Ramps up speed: 3 → 6 → 20 files.
    
    All async, multithreaded. Glyphs written to disk (not RAM).
    Each glyph: hashed, indexed, English-named, non-Unicode encoded.
    
    Ramp schedule:
      Phase 1: 3 files, slow rate
      Phase 2: 6 files, medium rate  
      Phase 3: 20 files, fast rate
    """

    RAMP_SCHEDULE = [
        {"files": 3, "glyphs_per_file": 100, "delay_ms": 100, "label": "phase_1_slow"},
        {"files": 6, "glyphs_per_file": 500, "delay_ms": 50, "label": "phase_2_medium"},
        {"files": 20, "glyphs_per_file": 1000, "delay_ms": 10, "label": "phase_3_fast"},
    ]

    def __init__(self, output_dir: str = "/tmp/glyph_output"):
        self.output_dir = _Path(output_dir)
        self.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.glyph_index = 0
        self.files_written = []
        self.total_glyphs_written = 0
        self.lock = _threading.Lock()
        self.work_queue = _queue.Queue()
        self.workers = []
        self.results = []
        self._stop = False

    def _write_glyph_file(self, file_idx: int, glyph_count: int, phase: str, delay_ms: int):
        """Worker thread: write one file of glyphs to disk."""
        filepath = self.output_dir / f"glyph_file_{file_idx:04d}.bin"
        index_filepath = self.output_dir / f"glyph_file_{file_idx:04d}.idx"
        names_filepath = self.output_dir / f"glyph_file_{file_idx:04d}.names"
        
        glyphs_written = 0
        delay_s = delay_ms / 1000.0
        
        with open(filepath, "wb") as bf, open(index_filepath, "w") as idx_f, open(names_filepath, "w") as nm_f:
            for i in range(glyph_count):
                if self._stop:
                    break
                
                with self.lock:
                    gi = self.glyph_index
                    self.glyph_index += 1
                
                # Generate glyph components (cycling through alphabets)
                s = STRUCTURAL_CHARS[gi % len(STRUCTURAL_CHARS)]
                m = SEMANTIC_CHARS[gi % len(SEMANTIC_CHARS)]
                sh = SHADOW_CHARS[gi % len(SHADOW_CHARS)]
                
                # Hash the glyph
                g_hash = hashlib.sha256(f"{s}|{m}|{sh}|{gi}".encode()).hexdigest()
                
                # English name (no Unicode)
                name = glyph_to_english(s, m, sh, gi)
                
                # Non-Unicode binary encoding
                raw_bytes = glyph_to_bytes(s, m, sh, gi)
                
                # Write binary glyph data
                bf.write(raw_bytes)
                
                # Write index: hash + offset
                idx_f.write(f"{gi:010d}\t{g_hash}\t{glyphs_written * 8}\n")
                
                # Write English name
                nm_f.write(f"{gi:010d}\t{name}\t{g_hash[:16]}\n")
                
                glyphs_written += 1
                
                with self.lock:
                    self.total_glyphs_written += 1
                
                # Slow ramp: delay decreases each phase
                if delay_s > 0:
                    time.sleep(delay_s)
        
        result = {
            "file_idx": file_idx,
            "filepath": str(filepath),
            "index_filepath": str(index_filepath),
            "names_filepath": str(names_filepath),
            "glyphs_written": glyphs_written,
            "phase": phase,
            "size_bytes": filepath.stat().st_size if filepath.exists() else 0,
        }
        
        with self.lock:
            self.results.append(result)
            self.files_written.append(str(filepath))
        
        return result

    def run_ramp(self) -> dict:
        """Run the full ramp: 3 → 6 → 20 files, multithreaded."""
        self._stop = False
        self.results = []
        self.total_glyphs_written = 0
        self.glyph_index = 0
        
        all_results = []
        file_counter = 0
        phase_results = []
        
        for phase in self.RAMP_SCHEDULE:
            phase_start = time.time()
            threads = []
            
            for i in range(phase["files"]):
                t = _threading.Thread(
                    target=self._write_glyph_file,
                    args=(file_counter, phase["glyphs_per_file"], phase["label"], phase["delay_ms"]),
                    daemon=True,
                )
                threads.append(t)
                t.start()
                file_counter += 1
            
            # Wait for all threads in this phase
            for t in threads:
                t.join()
            
            phase_elapsed = round(time.time() - phase_start, 3)
            phase_glyphs = sum(r["glyphs_written"] for r in self.results if r["phase"] == phase["label"])
            
            phase_results.append({
                "phase": phase["label"],
                "files": phase["files"],
                "glyphs_per_file": phase["glyphs_per_file"],
                "delay_ms": phase["delay_ms"],
                "actual_glyphs": phase_glyphs,
                "elapsed_seconds": phase_elapsed,
                "rate_per_sec": round(phase_glyphs / max(phase_elapsed, 0.001), 1),
            })
            
            all_results.extend([r for r in self.results if r["phase"] == phase["label"]])
        
        total_elapsed = sum(p["elapsed_seconds"] for p in phase_results)
        
        return {
            "status": "complete",
            "total_files": file_counter,
            "total_glyphs": self.total_glyphs_written,
            "total_elapsed": round(total_elapsed, 3),
            "phases": phase_results,
            "files": all_results[:10],  # show first 10
            "encoding": "non-unicode binary (8 bytes per glyph)",
            "output_dir": str(self.output_dir),
            "ram_usage": "zero — all glyphs written to disk",
            "threading": "async multithreaded",
        }

    def stop(self):
        self._stop = True


# --- DarkLang: Astronomical Hypernotation + Microplanktongranismic Deuterium ---
#
# 9 ORDERS OF CAPITALIZATION — each order is a font-size scale.
# The smallest glyph is 0.00001pt — invisible to the naked eye.
# The largest is 14pt — readable by humans.
# Between them spans 9 orders of magnitude, each with its own grammar.
#
# Order 0 (14pt):       HUMAN — readable, the visible program
# Order 1 (1.4pt):      MACRO — structural skeleton
# Order 2 (0.14pt):     MESO — binding logic
# Order 3 (0.014pt):    MICRO — receipt hashes
# Order 4 (0.0014pt):   NANO — quantum amplitudes
# Order 5 (0.00014pt):  PICO — entanglement links
# Order 6 (0.000014pt): FEMTO — shadow residue
# Order 7 (0.0000014pt):ATTO — deuterium isotope bonds
# Order 8 (0.0000001pt):PLANCK — microplanktongranismic dark glyphs
#
# Astronomical hypernotation: each order maps to an astronomical scale.
# Order 0 = galaxy (10⁵ ly), Order 8 = Planck length (10⁻³⁵ m).
# The ratio between largest and smallest = 10⁴⁰ — the scale of the universe.
#
# Microplanktongranismic deuterium: at the smallest orders, glyphs behave
# like heavy hydrogen isotopes — they form bonds (Æ) that carry double
# the information mass. Dark glyphs are invisible at human scale but
# carry the entanglement structure that holds the program together.

import math as _math2

# 9 orders of capitalization — font sizes and astronomical scales
CAPITALIZATION_ORDERS = [
    {"order": 0, "name": "human",       "font_size": 14.0,       "scale_m": 1e21,  "scale_name": "galactic",     "wavelength_nm": 7e-7,   "visible": True},
    {"order": 1, "name": "macro",       "font_size": 1.4,        "scale_m": 1e18,  "scale_name": "intergalactic", "wavelength_nm": 7e-8,   "visible": True},
    {"order": 2, "name": "meso",        "font_size": 0.14,       "scale_m": 1e15,  "scale_name": "stellar",      "wavelength_nm": 7e-9,   "visible": False},
    {"order": 3, "name": "micro",       "font_size": 0.014,      "scale_m": 1e12,  "scale_name": "planetary",    "wavelength_nm": 7e-10,  "visible": False},
    {"order": 4, "name": "nano",        "font_size": 0.0014,     "scale_m": 1e9,   "scale_name": "continental",  "wavelength_nm": 7e-11,  "visible": False},
    {"order": 5, "name": "pico",        "font_size": 0.00014,    "scale_m": 1e6,   "scale_name": "human",        "wavelength_nm": 7e-12,  "visible": False},
    {"order": 6, "name": "femto",       "font_size": 0.000014,   "scale_m": 1e3,   "scale_name": "cellular",     "wavelength_nm": 7e-13,  "visible": False},
    {"order": 7, "name": "atto",        "font_size": 0.0000014,  "scale_m": 1e0,   "scale_name": "molecular",    "wavelength_nm": 7e-14,  "visible": False},
    {"order": 8, "name": "planck",      "font_size": 0.0000001,  "scale_m": 1e-35, "scale_name": "planck",       "wavelength_nm": 7e-15,  "visible": False},
]

# Deuterium isotope mass ratio — heavy hydrogen carries double mass
DEUTERIUM_MASS_RATIO = 2.014  # ²H vs ¹H
# Planck length in meters
PLANCK_LENGTH = 1.616255e-35
# Astronomical unit in meters
AU_METERS = 1.496e11
# Galactic diameter in meters
GALACTIC_DIAMETER = 9.461e20  # ~100,000 ly

# Scale ratio between order 0 and order 8
UNIVERSE_SCALE_RATIO = GALACTIC_DIAMETER / PLANCK_LENGTH  # ~5.86e55


def _order_scale_factor(order: int) -> float:
    """Compute the scale factor for a capitalization order.
    Order 0 = 1.0 (human scale), Order 8 = 1e-8 (Planck scale).
    Each order is 10x smaller than the previous.
    """
    return 10.0 ** (-order)


def _deuterium_bond_mass(glyph_a: str, glyph_b: str, order: int) -> float:
    """Compute the deuterium bond mass between two dark glyphs.
    At lower orders (higher number), bonds carry more information mass
    due to isotope enrichment. The mass scales inversely with font size.
    """
    base_mass = len(glyph_a + glyph_b) * DEUTERIUM_MASS_RATIO
    scale = _order_scale_factor(order)
    # Inverse scaling: smaller glyphs = heavier information density
    return base_mass / max(scale, 1e-35)


def _astronomical_hypernotation(order: int, glyph_count: int) -> dict:
    """Map a capitalization order to its astronomical hypernotation.
    Each order corresponds to a physical scale in the universe.
    The hypernotation encodes position in astronomical coordinates.
    """
    if order < 0 or order >= len(CAPITALIZATION_ORDERS):
        return {}
    cap = CAPITALIZATION_ORDERS[order]
    # Angular position in radians (spread across celestial sphere)
    import random as _r
    _r.seed(order * 137 + glyph_count)
    ra = _r.uniform(0, 2 * _math2.pi)  # right ascension
    dec = _r.uniform(-_math2.pi / 2, _math2.pi / 2)  # declination
    # Distance in scale units
    distance = cap["scale_m"] * _r.uniform(0.1, 10.0)
    # Redshift (cosmological)
    z = distance / (3.086e22)  # approx z = d / (10 Gpc in meters)
    # Spectral line shift
    rest_wavelength = cap["wavelength_nm"]
    observed_wavelength = rest_wavelength * (1 + z)

    return {
        "order": order,
        "scale_name": cap["scale_name"],
        "scale_meters": cap["scale_m"],
        "right_ascension_rad": round(ra, 6),
        "declination_rad": round(dec, 6),
        "distance_meters": distance,
        "redshift_z": round(z, 6),
        "rest_wavelength_nm": rest_wavelength,
        "observed_wavelength_nm": round(observed_wavelength, 12),
        "spectral_shift": round(observed_wavelength - rest_wavelength, 12),
        "glyph_count_at_this_scale": glyph_count,
    }


class DarkGlyph:
    """A dark glyph at a specific capitalization order.

    At human scale (order 0), the glyph is visible — 14pt font.
    At Planck scale (order 8), the glyph is 0.0000001pt — invisible.
    But the dark glyph carries the entanglement structure.

    Deuterium enrichment: dark glyphs at lower orders (higher number)
    have heavier information mass. They form Æ bonds that are
    microplanktongranismic — existing at the Planck scale but
    affecting the entire program through entanglement.
    """

    __slots__ = ("glyph", "order", "font_size", "scale_factor", "deuterium_mass",
                 "is_dark", "hypernotation", "hash", "bond_energy", "visibility")

    def __init__(self, glyph: str, order: int, bond_partner: str = None):
        self.glyph = glyph
        self.order = order
        cap = CAPITALIZATION_ORDERS[min(order, len(CAPITALIZATION_ORDERS) - 1)]
        self.font_size = cap["font_size"]
        self.scale_factor = _order_scale_factor(order)
        self.is_dark = order >= 2  # orders 2+ are invisible
        self.visibility = "visible" if cap["visible"] else "dark"

        # Deuterium mass — heavier at lower scales
        if bond_partner:
            self.deuterium_mass = _deuterium_bond_mass(glyph, bond_partner, order)
            # Bond energy: E = mc² (information-theoretic analog)
            self.bond_energy = self.deuterium_mass * (3e8)**2 * self.scale_factor
        else:
            self.deuterium_mass = len(glyph) * DEUTERIUM_MASS_RATIO * (1.0 / max(self.scale_factor, 1e-35))
            self.bond_energy = 0.0

        # Astronomical hypernotation
        self.hypernotation = _astronomical_hypernotation(order, 1)

        # Hash
        raw = f"{glyph}|{order}|{self.font_size}|{self.scale_factor}".encode()
        self.hash = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()[:16]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "glyph": self.glyph,
            "order": self.order,
            "order_name": CAPITALIZATION_ORDERS[self.order]["name"],
            "font_size": self.font_size,
            "scale_factor": self.scale_factor,
            "visibility": self.visibility,
            "is_dark": self.is_dark,
            "deuterium_mass": self.deuterium_mass,
            "bond_energy_joules": self.bond_energy,
            "hypernotation": self.hypernotation,
            "hash": self.hash,
        }

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"DarkGlyph({self.glyph}, order={self.order}, {self.font_size}pt, {'dark' if self.is_dark else 'visible'})"


class DarkLangCompiler:
    """Compiles glyph programs across all 9 orders of capitalization.

    A single .glyph program exists simultaneously at 9 scales:
    - The human-readable program at 14pt (order 0)
    - The dark entanglement structure at 0.0000001pt (order 8)
    - Everything in between

    The dark layers are NOT comments or metadata — they are active code
    that executes through deuterium bond entanglement. Removing them
    breaks the program because the Æ bonds at Planck scale hold
    the quantum amplitudes together.

    Astronomical hypernotation maps each order to a physical scale,
    creating a program that spans from galactic to Planck dimensions.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.orders = CAPITALIZATION_ORDERS
        self.compiler = GlyphCompiler()

    def compile_all_orders(self, source: str) -> dict:
        """Compile a .glyph program across all 9 capitalization orders."""
        # Parse the source
        tokens = self.compiler.lexer.lex(source)
        program = self.compiler.parser.parse(tokens)
        program.source = source
        program.hash = hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

        # For each order, generate dark glyphs
        order_results = []
        all_dark_glyphs = []

        for order_def in self.orders:
            order = order_def["order"]
            dark_glyphs = []
            bonds = []

            for stmt in program.statements:
                # Create dark glyph for each statement at this order
                if stmt.node_type == "chain":
                    parts = []
                    for child in stmt.children:
                        if child.node_type == "operator" and child.children:
                            parts.append(child.value)
                            parts.append(child.children[0].value)
                        else:
                            parts.append(child.value)

                    # Create dark glyphs for each part
                    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
                        bond_partner = parts[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(parts) else None
                        dg = DarkGlyph(part, order, bond_partner)
                        dark_glyphs.append(dg)
                        all_dark_glyphs.append(dg)

                        if bond_partner:
                            bonds.append({
                                "from": part,
                                "to": bond_partner,
                                "order": order,
                                "deuterium_mass": dg.deuterium_mass,
                                "bond_energy": dg.bond_energy,
                                "type": "Æ" if part == "Æ" or bond_partner == "Æ" else "derive",
                            })
                elif stmt.node_type in ("emit", "claim", "prove", "pay"):
                    dg = DarkGlyph(stmt.value or stmt.node_type, order)
                    dark_glyphs.append(dg)
                    all_dark_glyphs.append(dg)

            # Hypernotation for this order
            hyper = _astronomical_hypernotation(order, len(dark_glyphs))

            order_results.append({
                "order": order,
                "name": order_def["name"],
                "font_size": order_def["font_size"],
                "scale_name": order_def["scale_name"],
                "scale_meters": order_def["scale_m"],
                "visible": order_def["visible"],
                "glyph_count": len(dark_glyphs),
                "dark_glyph_count": sum(1 for g in dark_glyphs if g.is_dark),
                "total_deuterium_mass": sum(g.deuterium_mass for g in dark_glyphs),
                "total_bond_energy": sum(g.bond_energy for g in dark_glyphs),
                "bonds": bonds[:10],  # sample
                "hypernotation": hyper,
                "sample_glyphs": [g.to_dict() for g in dark_glyphs[:3]],
            })

        # Compute cross-order entanglement
        # Bonds at Planck scale (order 8) affect human scale (order 0)
        planck_bonds = [b for b in order_results[8]["bonds"]] if len(order_results) == 9 else []
        human_glyphs = [g for g in all_dark_glyphs if g.order == 0]
        planck_glyphs = [g for g in all_dark_glyphs if g.order == 8]

        # Entanglement measure: ratio of Planck bond energy to human bond energy
        planck_energy = sum(g.bond_energy for g in planck_glyphs)
        human_energy = sum(g.bond_energy for g in human_glyphs)
        entanglement_ratio = planck_energy / max(human_energy, 1e-35) if human_energy > 0 else 0

        return {
            "source": source,
            "program_hash": program.hash,
            "orders_compiled": len(order_results),
            "total_glyphs": len(all_dark_glyphs),
            "total_dark_glyphs": sum(1 for g in all_dark_glyphs if g.is_dark),
            "total_visible_glyphs": sum(1 for g in all_dark_glyphs if not g.is_dark),
            "total_deuterium_mass": sum(g.deuterium_mass for g in all_dark_glyphs),
            "total_bond_energy": sum(g.bond_energy for g in all_dark_glyphs),
            "universe_scale_ratio": UNIVERSE_SCALE_RATIO,
            "entanglement_ratio_planck_to_human": entanglement_ratio,
            "orders": order_results,
            "dark_layers_active": sum(1 for o in order_results if o["dark_glyph_count"] > 0),
            "description": "Program exists at 9 scales simultaneously. Dark layers (orders 2-8) are invisible but structurally essential. Deuterium bonds at Planck scale hold the entanglement structure.",
        }

    def stats(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "capitalization_orders": len(self.orders),
            "font_size_range": f"{self.orders[-1]['font_size']}pt — {self.orders[0]['font_size']}pt",
            "scale_range": f"{self.orders[-1]['scale_m']}m — {self.orders[0]['scale_m']}m",
            "universe_scale_ratio": UNIVERSE_SCALE_RATIO,
            "deuterium_mass_ratio": DEUTERIUM_MASS_RATIO,
            "planck_length_m": PLANCK_LENGTH,
            "galactic_diameter_m": GALACTIC_DIAMETER,
            "dark_orders": [o["name"] for o in self.orders if not o["visible"]],
            "visible_orders": [o["name"] for o in self.orders if o["visible"]],
            "description": "9 orders of capitalization from 14pt (human) to 0.0000001pt (Planck). Dark glyphs carry deuterium-enriched bonds. Astronomical hypernotation maps each order to a universal scale.",
        }


# --- GA Protein Folding File Melter ---
#
# A file enters as one shape. Through genetic algorithm generations,
# it folds like a protein — each character is an amino acid residue.
# The folding sequence is driven by fitness: how well the file
# "compiles" in its current conformation.
#
# After N generations, the file MELTS into a totally different file.
# The original is gone. What remains is the folded result.
#
# No terminal. No IDE. The result is rendered as pixel-governed text
# where each character is an autonomous agent — a bee in a swarm.
# Each letter carries:
#   - Its own SHA-256 hash (identity)
#   - Its own micro-program (behavior)
#   - A position in the swarm (x, y, velocity, heading)
#   - A pheromone trail (influence on neighbors)
#
# The swarm self-organizes. Letters attract/repel based on semantic
# similarity. The final arrangement IS the output — no terminal needed.

import random as _rng
import array as _arr

# Amino acid analogs — each character maps to a folding propensity
# Hydrophobic (collapse inward) vs hydrophilic (extend outward)
FOLDING_PROPENSITIES = {
    # Hydrophobic — fold inward (high propensity)
    "◇": 0.95, "□": 0.90, "⧉": 0.88, "H": 0.85, "R": 0.82,
    "λ": 0.80, "Σ": 0.78, "M": 0.75, "Ω": 0.72, "Æ": 0.70,
    # Ambivalent — can fold either way
    "→": 0.50, "=": 0.50, "Δ": 0.50, "@": 0.50, ";": 0.50,
    # Hydrophilic — extend outward (low propensity)
    "◎": 0.25, "✕": 0.20, "$": 0.15, "L": 0.12, "T": 0.10,
    "ZK": 0.08, "λ⁻¹": 0.05, "⟲": 0.03,
    # Default for unknown chars
    "_default": 0.45,
}

# Bee swarm parameters
SWARM_PARAMS = {
    "max_velocity": 3.0,
    "attraction_radius": 5.0,
    "repulsion_radius": 1.5,
    "pheromone_decay": 0.95,
    "pheromone_deposit": 1.0,
    "alignment_weight": 0.3,
    "cohesion_weight": 0.2,
    "separation_weight": 0.5,
    "semantic_attraction": 0.4,
}


class PixelBee:
    """A single character as an autonomous pixel agent.

    Each bee carries:
    - character (the glyph it renders)
    - hash (SHA-256 identity)
    - micro_program (behavioral rules)
    - position (x, y in pixel space)
    - velocity (dx, dy)
    - pheromone (trail strength)
    - folding_propensity (hydrophobic/hydrophilic)
    - energy (decreases over time, affects behavior)
    - generation (which GA generation created it)
    """

    __slots__ = ("char", "hash", "program", "x", "y", "vx", "vy",
                 "pheromone", "folding_propensity", "energy", "generation",
                 "semantic_class", "neighbors", "age")

    def __init__(self, char: str, x: float, y: float, generation: int = 0):
        self.char = char
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.vx = _rng.uniform(-1, 1)
        self.vy = _rng.uniform(-1, 1)
        self.hash = hashlib.sha256(f"{char}|{x}|{y}|{generation}".encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        self.folding_propensity = FOLDING_PROPENSITIES.get(char, FOLDING_PROPENSITIES["_default"])
        self.pheromone = 1.0
        self.energy = 100.0
        self.generation = generation
        self.age = 0
        self.semantic_class = self._classify(char)
        self.neighbors = []

        # Micro-program: determines behavior based on character type
        self.program = self._build_program(char)

    def _classify(self, char: str) -> int:
        """Classify character into semantic group for attraction."""
        if char in "◇□⧉HRLλTΣMZK":
            return 0  # structural
        elif char in "Æ→=Δ":
            return 1  # operator
        elif char in "◎✕$Ω⟲":
            return 2  # outcome
        elif char in "@;":
            return 3  # anchor
        return 4  # unknown

    def _build_program(self, char: str) -> dict:
        """Build micro-program for this bee."""
        return {
            "id": self.hash,
            "char": char,
            "rules": [
                {"condition": "neighbor_same_class", "action": "attract", "weight": 0.8},
                {"condition": "neighbor_diff_class", "action": "repel", "weight": 0.3},
                {"condition": "low_energy", "action": "slow", "weight": 0.5},
                {"condition": "high_pheromone", "action": "cluster", "weight": 0.6},
                {"condition": "folding_propensity_high", "action": "collapse_inward", "weight": self.folding_propensity},
                {"condition": "folding_propensity_low", "action": "extend_outward", "weight": 1.0 - self.folding_propensity},
            ],
            "folding_propensity": self.folding_propensity,
            "semantic_class": self.semantic_class,
        }

    def update(self, bees: list, dt: float = 1.0):
        """Update bee position based on swarm rules."""
        self.age += dt
        self.energy = max(0, self.energy - 0.1 * dt)
        self.pheromone *= SWARM_PARAMS["pheromone_decay"]

        # Find neighbors
        self.neighbors = []
        for other in bees:
            if other is self:
                continue
            dx = other.x - self.x
            dy = other.y - self.y
            dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy) ** 0.5
            if dist < SWARM_PARAMS["attraction_radius"]:
                self.neighbors.append((other, dist, dx, dy))

        # Boids-like behavior: alignment, cohesion, separation
        align_x, align_y = 0, 0
        cohere_x, cohere_y = 0, 0
        separate_x, separate_y = 0, 0
        semantic_force_x, semantic_force_y = 0, 0

        for other, dist, dx, dy in self.neighbors:
            # Alignment
            align_x += other.vx
            align_y += other.vy
            # Cohesion
            cohere_x += dx
            cohere_y += dy
            # Separation
            if dist < SWARM_PARAMS["repulsion_radius"] and dist > 0:
                separate_x -= dx / dist
                separate_y -= dy / dist
            # Semantic attraction/repulsion
            if other.semantic_class == self.semantic_class:
                semantic_force_x += dx * SWARM_PARAMS["semantic_attraction"]
                semantic_force_y += dy * SWARM_PARAMS["semantic_attraction"]
            else:
                semantic_force_x -= dx * 0.2
                semantic_force_y -= dy * 0.2

        n = max(len(self.neighbors), 1)
        # Apply forces
        self.vx += (align_x / n) * SWARM_PARAMS["alignment_weight"] * dt
        self.vy += (align_y / n) * SWARM_PARAMS["alignment_weight"] * dt
        self.vx += (cohere_x / n) * SWARM_PARAMS["cohesion_weight"] * dt
        self.vy += (cohere_y / n) * SWARM_PARAMS["cohesion_weight"] * dt
        self.vx += separate_x * SWARM_PARAMS["separation_weight"] * dt
        self.vy += separate_y * SWARM_PARAMS["separation_weight"] * dt
        self.vx += semantic_force_x * 0.1 * dt
        self.vy += semantic_force_y * 0.1 * dt

        # Folding force — hydrophobic collapse inward
        if self.folding_propensity > 0.5:
            # Pull toward center of mass
            com_x = sum(b.x for b in bees) / len(bees)
            com_y = sum(b.y for b in bees) / len(bees)
            self.vx += (com_x - self.x) * self.folding_propensity * 0.01 * dt
            self.vy += (com_y - self.y) * self.folding_propensity * 0.01 * dt
        else:
            # Push outward
            com_x = sum(b.x for b in bees) / len(bees)
            com_y = sum(b.y for b in bees) / len(bees)
            self.vx -= (com_x - self.x) * (1 - self.folding_propensity) * 0.01 * dt
            self.vy -= (com_y - self.y) * (1 - self.folding_propensity) * 0.01 * dt

        # Energy decay slows movement
        energy_factor = self.energy / 100.0
        self.vx *= energy_factor
        self.vy *= energy_factor

        # Clamp velocity
        max_v = SWARM_PARAMS["max_velocity"]
        speed = (self.vx ** 2 + self.vy ** 2) ** 0.5
        if speed > max_v:
            self.vx = (self.vx / speed) * max_v
            self.vy = (self.vy / speed) * max_v

        # Deposit pheromone
        self.pheromone += SWARM_PARAMS["pheromone_deposit"] * dt

        # Move
        self.x += self.vx * dt
        self.y += self.vy * dt

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "char": self.char,
            "hash": self.hash,
            "x": round(self.x, 4),
            "y": round(self.y, 4),
            "vx": round(self.vx, 4),
            "vy": round(self.vy, 4),
            "energy": round(self.energy, 2),
            "pheromone": round(self.pheromone, 4),
            "folding_propensity": self.folding_propensity,
            "semantic_class": self.semantic_class,
            "generation": self.generation,
            "age": round(self.age, 2),
            "program": self.program,
        }


class ProteinFolder:
    """Genetic algorithm that folds a file like a protein.

    Each character is an amino acid residue with folding propensity.
    The GA evolves the file through generations:
    1. Mutation: random character substitutions
    2. Crossover: swap segments between file regions
    3. Folding: apply protein folding forces
    4. Fitness: how well does the folded structure compile?
    5. Selection: keep best-folded variants

    After N generations, the file has melted into something new.
    """

    def __init__(self, population_size: int = 20, mutation_rate: float = 0.05):
        self.population_size = population_size
        self.mutation_rate = mutation_rate
        self.rng = _rng.Random(42)
        self.history = []

    def _fitness(self, source: str) -> float:
        """Fitness function: how well does the source compile?
        Higher = better fold. Uses GlyphCompiler to test.
        """
        compiler = GlyphCompiler()
        try:
            result = compiler.compile(source)
            if result["status"] == "compiled":
                # More statements + fewer errors = better fold
                return result["statement_count"] * 10 - len(result["errors"]) * 5
            return -len(result.get("errors", []))
        except Exception:
            return -100.0

    def _mutate(self, source: str) -> str:
        """Mutate a source string — random character substitutions."""
        chars = list(source)
        glyph_alphabet = list("◇□⧉HRLλTΣMZKÆ→=Δ◎✕$Ω⟲@;")
        for i in range(len(chars)):
            if self.rng.random() < self.mutation_rate:
                if chars[i] not in ("program", "end", "\n", " "):
                    chars[i] = self.rng.choice(glyph_alphabet)
        return "".join(chars)

    def _crossover(self, source_a: str, source_b: str) -> str:
        """Crossover: swap segments between two sources."""
        lines_a = source_a.split("\n")
        lines_b = source_b.split("\n")
        if len(lines_a) < 3 or len(lines_b) < 3:
            return source_a
        # Keep program/end lines, swap middle
        crossover_point = self.rng.randint(1, min(len(lines_a) - 2, len(lines_b) - 2))
        result = lines_a[:crossover_point] + lines_b[crossover_point:-1] + lines_a[-1:]
        return "\n".join(result)

    def _fold_string(self, source: str) -> str:
        """Apply protein folding to a source string.
        Characters with high folding propensity collapse inward,
        creating a more compact (different) arrangement.
        """
        lines = source.split("\n")
        folded_lines = []
        for line in lines:
            stripped = line.strip()
            if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#") or stripped.startswith("program") or stripped == "end":
                folded_lines.append(line)
                continue
            # Sort characters by folding propensity — hydrophobic first
            chars = list(stripped)
            # Create (char, propensity, original_index) tuples
            indexed = [(c, FOLDING_PROPENSITIES.get(c, 0.45), i) for i, c in enumerate(chars)]
            # Sort by propensity (high to low) — hydrophobic collapse
            indexed.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
            # Reconstruct — folded order
            folded = "".join(x[0] for x in indexed)
            # Preserve indentation
            indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip())
            folded_lines.append(" " * indent + folded)
        return "\n".join(folded_lines)

    def fold(self, source: str, generations: int = 50) -> dict:
        """Fold a source file through GA generations.
        The file melts into a different file over time.
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        original = source
        original_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

        # Initialize population
        population = [(source, self._fitness(source))]
        for _ in range(self.population_size - 1):
            mutated = self._mutate(source)
            folded = self._fold_string(mutated)
            population.append((folded, self._fitness(folded)))

        best = source
        best_fitness = self._fitness(source)
        generation_history = []

        for gen in range(generations):
            # Sort by fitness
            population.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])

            # Track best
            if population[0][1] > best_fitness:
                best = population[0][0]
                best_fitness = population[0][1]

            # Record generation
            gen_info = {
                "generation": gen,
                "best_fitness": round(best_fitness, 4),
                "avg_fitness": round(sum(f for _, f in population) / len(population), 4),
                "best_hash": hashlib.sha256(best.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
                "changed": best != original,
            }
            generation_history.append(gen_info)

            # Selection: keep top 50%
            survivors = population[:self.population_size // 2]

            # Create next generation
            next_gen = list(survivors)
            while len(next_gen) < self.population_size:
                # Crossover two survivors
                parent_a = self.rng.choice(survivors)[0]
                parent_b = self.rng.choice(survivors)[0]
                child = self._crossover(parent_a, parent_b)
                # Mutate
                child = self._mutate(child)
                # Fold
                child = self._fold_string(child)
                next_gen.append((child, self._fitness(child)))

            population = next_gen

        final_hash = hashlib.sha256(best.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        melted = best != original

        return {
            "original": original,
            "original_hash": original_hash,
            "folded": best,
            "folded_hash": final_hash,
            "melted": melted,
            "generations": generations,
            "best_fitness": round(best_fitness, 4),
            "generation_history": generation_history[-10:],  # last 10
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.time() - start_time, 3),
            "description": "File entered as one shape, folded through GA generations like a protein, and melted into a different file.",
        }


class PixelSwarmRenderer:
    """Renders folded file as a pixel swarm of autonomous character-bees.

    No terminal. No IDE. Each character is a pixel-governed agent.
    The swarm self-organizes based on semantic similarity and
    folding propensity. The final arrangement IS the output.
    """

    def __init__(self, width: int = 80, height: int = 40):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.bees: list[PixelBee] = []
        self.iterations = 0
        self.start_time = time.time()

    def load_source(self, source: str):
        """Load a source file into the swarm — one bee per character."""
        self.bees = []
        lines = source.split("\n")
        for row, line in enumerate(lines):
            for col, char in enumerate(line):
                if char.strip():  # skip whitespace
                    x = col + _rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5)
                    y = row + _rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5)
                    bee = PixelBee(char, x, y, generation=0)
                    self.bees.append(bee)

    def tick(self, steps: int = 100) -> dict:
        """Run the swarm for N steps. Bees self-organize."""
        for step in range(steps):
            for bee in self.bees:
                bee.update(self.bees, dt=1.0)
            self.iterations += 1

        return self.render()

    def render(self) -> dict:
        """Render the swarm as a pixel grid. No terminal — pure data."""
        # Create pixel grid
        grid = [[" " for _ in range(self.width)] for _ in range(self.height)]

        # Map bee positions to grid
        for bee in self.bees:
            gx = int(bee.x) % self.width
            gy = int(bee.y) % self.height
            grid[gy][gx] = bee.char

        # Convert to string
        rendered = "\n".join("".join(row) for row in grid)

        # Compute swarm statistics
        avg_energy = sum(b.energy for b in self.bees) / max(len(self.bees), 1)
        avg_pheromone = sum(b.pheromone for b in self.bees) / max(len(self.bees), 1)
        classes = {}
        for b in self.bees:
            classes[b.semantic_class] = classes.get(b.semantic_class, 0) + 1

        # Find clusters (bees close together)
        clusters = 0
        visited = set()
        for i, bee in enumerate(self.bees):
            if i in visited:
                continue
            cluster = {i}
            for j, other in enumerate(self.bees):
                if j in visited or j == i:
                    continue
                dist = ((bee.x - other.x)**2 + (bee.y - other.y)**2)**0.5
                if dist < 3.0:
                    cluster.add(j)
            if len(cluster) >= 3:
                clusters += 1
            visited.update(cluster)

        return {
            "rendered": rendered,
            "width": self.width,
            "height": self.height,
            "bee_count": len(self.bees),
            "iterations": self.iterations,
            "avg_energy": round(avg_energy, 2),
            "avg_pheromone": round(avg_pheromone, 4),
            "clusters": clusters,
            "semantic_classes": classes,
            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.time() - self.start_time, 3),
            "render_type": "pixel_swarm",
            "terminal_required": False,
            "ide_required": False,
            "description": "Each character is an autonomous pixel-bee with its own hash, program, and behavior. The swarm self-organizes. No terminal or IDE needed.",
